About me

Ingredient science, told as a story

Good UGC should do more than look beautiful — it should make viewers curious, informed, and ready to take action.

Hi, I’m Stephanie. I’m a skincare UGC creator and nursing student specializing in clinical authority, authentic skin texture, and narrative-driven direct response.

Instead of just showcasing a bottle, I bridge the gap between active ingredient science and real-life skin recovery. My approach pairs thoughtful product demonstrations and clean B-roll with unfiltered storytelling that answers the buyer’s core questions: why this works, what to expect, and how it fits into their routine.

Every asset is engineered for high retention, genuine consumer trust, and scalable ad performance.

Capabilities & Deliverables

What I Bring to Every Creative Brief

  1. 1

    High-Definition Texture & Product Demos

    Crisp macro framing and smooth slow-motion application that highlight formula viscosity, skin finish, and sensory appeal.

  2. 2

    Frictionless Routine Sequencing

    Step-by-step application flows that show viewers exactly where, when, and how products fit into a daily routine, removing buyer hesitation.

  3. 3

    Paced Voiceover Narration

    Engaging, natural voiceovers timed precisely to on-screen action, holding attention and guiding viewers without feeling scripted.

  4. 4

    Educational Product Translation

    Demystifying active ingredients, barrier health, and skin concerns so cold viewers instantly understand why a formula works.

  5. 5

    Multi-Hook Variation Testing

    Developing distinct 3-second visual and audio hooks to help paid media teams test scroll-stop rates and combat ad fatigue.
